name: cable low row with rope attachment
description: A seated cable row using a rope that lets your hands travel close to your body. It targets the lats and mid back.
instructions: Sit at the low pulley with the rope attached, feet on the platform and knees slightly bent.
Grab the rope ends with a neutral grip and sit tall.
Pull the rope toward your lower stomach, driving your elbows back.
Return slowly until your arms are straight without rounding your back.
